parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is complaining about the robber on Hex 14 (Wheat 9). While it does hit him, it's essential to keep it there to block Ziv's city. The dice roll was a 12, which actually gave me a Wood (from Hex 1, Node 9), while Shon and Ziv got nothing. I'll acknowledge Shon's frustration briefly since he's an old friend, but I won't move it willingly.
parsed.note_to_self: Shon is feeling the squeeze from the block on 9. Ziv's city on that hex remains the biggest threat. I just gained a wood from the 12 roll.
parsed.say_outloud: מצטערת שון, זה באמת לא אישי. ה-9 הזה פשוט חזק מדי אצל זיו.
